answer: Honeypots with a known-bad answer. Grade one as correct and the epoch is void. Try to link two identities and the standing resets to zero. Auditors rotate from a pool the operator never sees, so a bought seat expires in a round or two. I have watched farms survive worse, but not this: the dune of shell accounts has to guess which tasks are traps, and the summit of its budget is a hollow number once one wrong grade wipes the round.
